name: library-01
title: Library 01
description: A file library page — a resizable FolderTree pane beside the open folder's breadcrumb, header, uploads in flight and contents as a list or a grid, with the FileViewer and a Move dialog.

meta.whenToUse: A page for a team's files and pages — folders in Shared and Private, uploads, a list or grid of a folder's contents, a viewer and moves; copy it once and wire it to your storage API.
meta.whenNotToUse: A few files on a record (AttachmentGroup) or a single upload form (UploadDialog).
